title: Agents get JavaScript and clearer paths into Pollinations
summary:
JavaScript for Computer MCP, a TypeSafe decision API alias, and five community apps led a day of making the edges less surprising.

Computer MCP added a `javascript` tool alongside bash, with persistent file access and JSON results. A Quests contribution added a discoverable SDK skill for agents, and the homepage gained a short Markdown response for agents that request one. Agent owners also get more useful deploy and MCP failure messages; the agent guides were updated to match current behavior.

`POST /v1/systemone` was added as an alias for TypeSafe decisions, accepting the same requests as `/alpha/decisions`. OAuth metadata now advertises supported scopes so clients can discover what to request. Updated references cover the new path, asynchronous media jobs, and account-free prepaid keys; those latter two changes are documentation, not new API capabilities.

Five community apps joined the catalog: Echo Island makes illustrated stories and voice notes; PolliCraft and PollinationsCraft bring Pollinations into Minecraft; and Switchyard and Trolley Match compare players' choices with Jev's decisions. Six more people were added to the community-model publisher list, while model and agent creation screens now explain that saved changes can take a minute or two to become callable.

highlights.title: JavaScript joins Computer MCP
highlights.text: Agents can run a JavaScript ES module function alongside bash, work with persistent files, and receive its output and return value as JSON. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: System One gets a v1 path
highlights.text: Send TypeSafe decision requests to `POST /v1/systemone` using the same request and response shape as `/alpha/decisions`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: OAuth scopes become discoverable
highlights.text: OAuth clients can read the supported generate, profile, usage, keys, and machines scopes from authorization metadata before requesting access. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: An SDK skill for agents
highlights.text: Agents can discover a JavaScript `@pollinations/sdk` quickstart covering authentication, text generation, and saving a generated image. [Explore the SDK](https://react.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: The homepage speaks Markdown
highlights.text: Agents requesting `text/markdown` from the pollinations.ai homepage get a short Markdown introduction and a link to the agent entry point. [Visit pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai).
